raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the Ensembl genome browser 113 as the source for the most relevant dog genome files as of May 2020. The correct link is from the Broad Institute's FTP server (`ftp://ftp.broadinstitute.org/distribution/assemblies/mammals/dog/canFam3.1/`), which is widely recognized as hosting the CanFam3.1 genome assembly—the most relevant version during that time. WebSurfer failed to locate or prioritize the Broad Institute's FTP link in its search results and instead focused on Ensembl, which led to the wrong solution being proposed.
